literature_notes: The sole ledger line (L1) describes expression of full-length CD160-GPI and CD160-TM isoforms in TPR reporter cells via retroviral/lentiviral transduction for functional signaling studies. The actual quote — 'TPR cells expressing BTLA, HVEM, 4-1BB, CD160-GPI, CD160-TM and chimeric mICOS receptors were also generated by retroviral and lentiviral transductions' — reports no epitope-tag knock-in, fluorescent-protein fusion, transposon/domain-insertion screen, or antibody-epitope insertion at any residue. No tag type is named, no junction residue is named, and no tag position is stated. L1 therefore does not satisfy the qualification criterion ('a line qualifies only if it reports an insertion actually TOLERATED'). With no qualifying ledger line, zero sites are proposed. Topologically, CD160 is a GPI-anchored single-domain IgV protein (signal peptide 1–24, entire mature ectodomain 25–181); an N-terminal tag after residue 24 would be extracellular and structurally plausible, but structural inference alone is explicitly forbidden as a basis for proposing a site.
